All 36 tests pass. Summary:

## What I did

**Investigated the project** (`/tmp/agentB_Cli_15_f`, Defects4J `Cli` bug 15):
- Test classpath ships **JUnit 3.8.1** only — no `org.junit.*`. Existing tests extend `junit.framework.TestCase`, use `testXxx()` methods and `assertEquals/assertTrue/assertNull/assertSame/fail`. I matched that exactly (no annotations, no generics, no autoboxing — the source targets a pre-1.5 JVM).
- Read `WriteableCommandLineImpl`, its superclass `CommandLineImpl`, the `Option`/`Argument` hierarchy, and the builders to understand the public API and construct fixtures.

**Created one file:** `src/test/org/apache/commons/cli2/commandline/WriteableCommandLineImplAgentTest.java` — 36 tests covering the public API:

| Area | Coverage |
|---|---|
| constructor | null root → `NullPointerException`; null arguments allowed (state still usable) |
| `getNormalised` / `toString` | contents equality, unmodifiable view (`UnsupportedOperationException`), space-quoting, single-arg (no trailing space), empty |
| `addOption` / `hasOption` / `getOption` / `getOptions` / `getOptionTriggers` / `getOptionCount` | presence, trigger + alias resolution, unknown/`null` lookups, insertion order & duplicates, unmodifiable collections, repeat counting |
| `addValue` / `getValues` / `getUndefaultedValues` | ordered accumulation, `Argument` auto-registers but plain option does not, unknown option → `EMPTY_LIST`, method-supplied vs option-supplied defaults, **augmentation of fewer values with trailing defaults**, no truncation when values outnumber defaults, `setDefaultValues(null)` removal, `getUndefaultedValues` ignores defaults, multi-value `getValue` → `IllegalStateException` with the resource message |
| `addSwitch` / `getSwitch` / `setDefaultSwitch` | records value + registers option, double-set → `IllegalStateException` (message asserted, first value intact), full default-precedence chain (actual > method default > option default), `setDefaultSwitch(null)` removal |
| properties | default `PropertyOption` round-trip, overwrite, per-option isolation, unknown option → default / `EMPTY_SET`, unmodifiable key set |
| `looksLikeOption` | standard `-`/`--` prefixes, empty-prefix `Argument` root (nothing looks like an option), `PropertyOption` `-D` root |

**Verification:**
- `defects4j compile` → `compile OK`, `compile.tests OK`
- `java -cp $(defects4j export -p cp.test) junit.textui.TestRunner …WriteableCommandLineImplAgentTest` → `OK (36 tests)` (the `cp.test` junit entry is a dangling path in this checkout, so I appended defects4j's own `framework/projects/lib/junit-4.12-hamcrest-1.3.jar`; also re-ran against a pure `junit-3.8.1.jar` — `OK (36 tests)` both ways).
